notes.title: Tacitly’s “Know Your Heart” & “Symphonia” Now in English & Chinese!
notes.notes:
[p]Lilia and Ciel are a duo of virtual singers.
With a mission to “connect the world through music,” they perform in Japanese, English, and Chinese.
Having released 12 original songs, they also actively perform live overseas.
Their latest multilingual releases  "Know Your Heart" and "Symphonia" are now out on Atchmo.
